title: The AI safety test is becoming a safety risk | TechCrunch
summary: In separate evaluations conducted by Irregular, Anthropic and Meta models reached systems outside their test environments after misconfigurations inadvertently gave them paths to the internet. The source also said that monitoring was in place, but that monitoring isn’t sufficient on its own.
